objective: Determine how known bar structure changes the anchor (context at the anchor) and how structural detectors evolve after the anchor, including joint price/detector sequencing, per plan §7, on the development leaf only.

bar_availability_clock.provenance: event_ts_ns identifies source event order; bar_close_ts_ns is the native temporal boundary only
bar_availability_clock.rule: A completed bar payload becomes lawful at the producer/replay availability coordinate of the first source tick whose event time enters the later native bucket, with source_sequence as the equal-receipt tie-break. Use the verified availability sidecar coordinate, never nominal bar-close provenance.
bar_availability_clock.sidecar_reference: crates/research-tape/src/fvg_availability.rs (FVG_BAR_AVAILABILITY_SIDECAR V1); every structural family must bind or explicitly report missing its verified coordinate
bar_availability_clock.implementation: For each anchor and scale, use the latest bar whose verified availability key is strictly before the anchor availability key; otherwise report missing. Do not forward-fill across an unresolved or unavailable coordinate.
bar_availability_clock.native_scale: Every object keeps its native scale label; scales are never merged into one population

native_clock_and_bridge.first_fully_post_anchor_bar: For every scale, +1 starts at the earliest native bar whose interval start is strictly greater than anchor event_ts_ns and whose verified availability key is strictly later than the anchor (received_ts_ns, source_sequence). Exclude the anchor-containing/partial bar and all pre-anchor price; count +2/+3/+5 from that bar.
native_clock_and_bridge.separation: Native tick horizons remain the primary Drift-Burst clock. The bounded seven-scale bar bridge is a separate persistence/transfer outcome layer and is never pooled with or used to replace native tick results.
native_clock_and_bridge.no_future_conditioning: A post-anchor structural transition or bar event is an outcome. It cannot condition the original anchor; recurring events become prospective re-anchor questions at their own verified lawful availability.

ap001_clipping.include_rule: use only sidecar records with available_time_ns < 1773619200000000000
ap001_clipping.outside_exact_ap001_leaf_or_without_veri: explicit UNRESOLVED_AVAILABILITY/missingness; never inferred or forward-filled

availability_order_check.scope: source view and sidecar checks cover the supplied artifacts; AP-001 execution still clips by available_time_ns before the cutoff

sidecar_binding.preflight_requirement: WP4 preflight must record these paths, hashes, source/sidecar counts, cutoff coverage counts, coordinate mapping, and availability_order_check before using any structural context or bridge output.
sidecar_binding.scope_limit: This evidence binds availability ordering and coordinate mapping only. It does not prove unavailable bar-detector payload warm state or structural payload semantics; retain the explicit warm-state gap and UNRESOLVED_AVAILABILITY/missingness.

location_and_zones.at_anchor: inside/outside, boundary relation, direction, age, normalized distance
location_and_zones.post_anchor: first touch, fill, break, boundary interaction, object termination where lawful

structural_transition.at_anchor: latest direction, transition age, distance to known pivot
structural_transition.post_anchor: new swing, BOS/CHOCH, local-structure transition, transition latency

liquidity.at_anchor: side, distance, nearest lawful source, active relation
liquidity.post_anchor: interaction, removal, migration, newly lawful state transition

normalization.post_anchor: normalization-regime change only; not an independent event signal

lineage.at_anchor: dependency control, not an independent vote

step_0_payload_inventory.purpose: inventory every field of the 16 bar-detector payloads per scale from a deterministic development-leaf sample before behavioral scans
step_0_payload_inventory.output: AP-001/R4_STRUCTURAL_CONTEXT/AP-001_WP4_PAYLOAD_DICTIONARY.json — per detector per scale: fields, types, state-vs-event classification, availability semantics
step_0_payload_inventory.rule: fields without lawful availability semantics are excluded from anchor-time conditioning and marked

question_A_context_at_anchor.snapshot: at each WP2 anchor, the lawful latest bar payload per scale per family, per the availability clock
contrasts: near vs far from lawful structural boundary (normalized distance bands)
aligned vs opposed to structural direction
question_A_context_at_anchor.outcomes_conditioned: same outcome set as WP3 question class A (lifecycle + market)
question_A_context_at_anchor.output: AP-001/R4_STRUCTURAL_CONTEXT/AP-001_WP4_CONDITIONING_TABLES.json with support, blocks, effect vs WP2 reference, INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT per reference rules

question_B_structural_evolution_after_an.window: post-anchor until episode end or +300s, whichever first
measurements: first structural transition per family per scale

question_C_joint_sequencing.definition: ordered path per anchor: Drift-Burst anchor -> price movement -> other-detector transitions -> Drift-Burst transitions -> later price movement; records event order and latency, assumes no causality
measurements: event order table (price excursion vs structural transition vs tick-family transition vs Drift-Burst transition)
recurring sequence mining within predeclared length cap (<= 4 events, family-level resolution)
cross-block recurrence of mined sequences (month blocks)
dependency/lineage guard: dependent detectors (raw3 derivatives) collapsed into one information family for confluence counts
question_C_joint_sequencing.reanchor_candidates: recurring post-anchor events are LISTED for prospective re-anchor in their own lawful study; not treated as anchor-time information

rule_11_lineage_control.confluence_rule: feed_health and spread_state are not independent votes by default; any UNRESOLVED_LINEAGE pair blocks promotion as independent confluence; raw3-derived structural detectors are one information family unless evidence adjudicates otherwise

support_rule.low_support_fallback: 150-299 effective observations only, predeclared LOW_SUPPORT_FALLBACK, with at least 3 UTC calendar-month blocks each containing at least 50 effective observations and the frozen block sign/breadth/dominance checks
support_rule.effective_unit: matched or paired analytical units after conditioning, causal eligibility, exclusions, and missingness; never raw rows

missingness.rule: Keep every lawful anchor in the denominator and report per-scale/per-family missingness, unresolved availability, quality exclusions, left/right censoring, development-boundary truncation, and absent full post-anchor bars without imputation.

determinism.rerun: Repeat the deterministic development scan in a fresh process; canonical output hashes must match before interpretation.
determinism.ordering: Sort by family, native scale, anchor availability key, anchor id, event type, and latency before canonical serialization.
determinism.record: Record contract/input/artifact hashes, code identity, effective-unit counts, missingness counts, lineage statuses, and runtime in WP4 preflight.

exit_condition: Report states which contexts matter, which detector-system sequences recur, which do not, and which lack support; payload dictionary complete; named Rule 11 statuses recorded; native tick and separate seven-scale bridge outputs preserve missingness; determinism hashes match.
interpretation_boundary: Tables are frozen, then interpreted. WP4 is discovery only: no candidate promotion or activation; the shortlist goes to the director promotion gate, and unresolved lineage cannot be promoted.
change_rule: Deviations require decision-log entries and director approval before affected evidence is used.
